items.title: Rossano Sportiello interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 2, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Michael Jackson tunes and stuff like that

ctx.x: I’m going to ask you to pull up that microphone clip a little bit, maybe up, yeah, good. It was just rubbing on your coat a little bit. So tell me about the kind of gigs you played in Milan when you were still a teenager. Were they all jazz gigs? Were they dance gigs?

Yeah it’s the usual combination that applies to this very day. Sometimes it’s a concert in a jazz club. Sometimes it’s a jazz concert in a theater. Sometimes it was a jazz festival. Sometimes it was just a restaurant gig, background. Sometimes it was a wedding. Now the trouble back then happened most of the time when you were engaged to play on parties, weddings or — because I learned very, very soon to make sure that the people that engaged the band were aware of the kind of music we played. Because if you show…
